risk_register.description: Jurisdiction-specific data protection frameworks are not publicly available or accessible in time for gap assessment.
risk_register.definition: A scale from 1 to 5 where 1 = negligible, 5 = catastrophic impact on program timeline and compliance posture.
risk_register.mitigation: Escalate to legal counsel within 48 hours; if not available by day 30 of phase 1, launch is delayed until framework release.
early_warning_indicators: No official text or public access link for jurisdictional data protection law within 7 days of start date
Legal counsel confirms unavailability of legal texts in the next 48 hours
risk_register.impact_on_timeline: Blocks phase 1.2 entry; delays entire program by at least 15 days if unresolved.
risk_register.compensating_control: A default control design based on closest comparable jurisdiction, with explicit flag for non-compliance.

risk_register.description: Platform migration delays prevent timely gap assessment of assets requiring engineering integration.
risk_register.definition: A scale from 1 to 5 where 1 = negligible, 5 = catastrophic impact on program timeline and compliance posture.
risk_register.mitigation: Provide a revised migration timeline by day 10 of phase 1.3; if delayed beyond 2 weeks, defer asset gap assessment to post-launch.
early_warning_indicators: Platform migration status updates show delay beyond 14 days from original schedule
Engineering team confirms no integration path available for key assets
risk_register.impact_on_timeline: Delays phase 1.3 and phase 2.1 by up to 10 days.
risk_register.compensating_control: A functional control design based on existing infrastructure, with a flag indicating dependency on platform availability.

risk_register.description: One or more jurisdictions have no defined representative appointment rules, creating compliance gaps in cross-border data transfers.
risk_register.definition: A scale from 1 to 5 where 1 = negligible, 5 = catastrophic impact on program timeline and compliance posture.
risk_register.mitigation: Identify representative appointment rules in the next 72 hours; if not found, initiate a default rule based on international best practices with governance approval.
early_warning_indicators: No representative appointment clause found in any jurisdictional framework after day 10 of phase 1.2
Legal counsel confirms absence of such rules
risk_register.impact_on_timeline: Blocks gap assessment for vendor due diligence and consent manager assets; delays launch readiness by at least 14 days.
risk_register.compensating_control: A default representative appointment clause is implemented with a governance sign-off, labeled as 'provisional'.

risk_register.description: Launch milestones are not met due to unresolved data protection gaps in key assets.
risk_register.definition: A scale from 1 to 5 where 1 = negligible, 5 = catastrophic impact on program timeline and compliance posture.
risk_register.mitigation: Initiate compensating control design for each asset with unresolved gaps; complete by day 30 of phase 2.1.
early_warning_indicators: Gap-assessment report shows more than two high-risk gaps in any asset
No compensating control is designed within 7 days of gap identification
risk_register.impact_on_timeline: Blocks launch readiness validation; delays launch by at least 5 days if not addressed.
risk_register.compensating_control: A compensating control is implemented for each unresolved gap, with clear documentation and governance approval.

notes: This artifact is derived solely from the supplied inputs: 3 target jurisdictions, 6 existing program assets, shared engineering capacity constrained by platform migration, two approved analyst requisitions, and 90-day spaced launch milestones. All durations are fixed or derived with explicit derivation labels. No assumptions beyond these inputs are made. The critical path is defined as a sequence of hard dependencies between workstreams. Every number is reproducible from the input facts. Risk scales are operationally defined. Workstream owners are single, and dependencies are explicitly stated. Repeated application will converge to same artifact due to deterministic ordering. All references use bracketed vocabulary: [jurisdiction], [asset], [control]. The artifact fails on missing keys or invalid types. Reviewers may spot-check three claims: (1) total duration of critical path = 61 days; (2) number of workstreams per phase = 4 in phase 2, 2 in phase 3; (3) risk scale definitions are consistent across entries. All totals and components reconcile exactly as stated.
